name: aohys.com
description: Public source site and private operations workspace for AOHYS.

scripts.cloudflare:local: pnpm --filter @aohys/site build && pnpm exec wrangler pages dev apps/site/dist --compatibility-date=2026-06-29
scripts.deploy:preview: pnpm run release:env:preview && pnpm run observability:audit:deploy && pnpm run audit:posthog-env && pnpm run sync:cloudflare-pages-runtime:preview && pnpm run audit:cloudflare-pages-runtime && pnpm run sync:convex-env:preview && env -u CONVEX_DEPLOYMENT pnpm --filter @aohys/backend exec convex deploy --typecheck enable --codegen enable --message "preview release" && pnpm run seed:dashboard:preview && pnpm run publish:content:build && AOHYS_DASHBOARD_CONTENT_APPLIED=1 pnpm run verify:published-content && pnpm exec wrangler pages deploy apps/site/dist --project-name aohys-com --branch develop
scripts.deploy:production: pnpm run release:env:production && pnpm run observability:audit:deploy && pnpm run audit:posthog-env && pnpm run sync:cloudflare-pages-runtime:production && pnpm run audit:cloudflare-pages-runtime && pnpm run sync:convex-env:production && env -u CONVEX_DEPLOYMENT pnpm --filter @aohys/backend exec convex deploy --typecheck enable --codegen enable --message "production release" && pnpm run publish:content:build && AOHYS_DASHBOARD_CONTENT_APPLIED=1 pnpm run verify:published-content && pnpm exec wrangler pages deploy apps/site/dist --project-name aohys-com --branch main && pnpm run ensure:cloudflare-production-domain
scripts.quality:commit: pnpm run verify:foundation && pnpm run react:doctor:staged
scripts.quality:changed: node scripts/quality/run-changed-validation.mjs && node scripts/run-react-doctor-changed.mjs && pnpm run verify:product
scripts.quality:certify: pnpm run verify:ci && pnpm run react:doctor:changed && pnpm run verify:product
scripts.quality:provider-readiness: pnpm run release:env:preview && pnpm run audit:posthog-env && pnpm run audit:cloudflare-pages-runtime
scripts.test: pnpm run architecture:fitness && pnpm run performance:test && pnpm run observability:check && pnpm run test:cloudflare-pages-runtime && pnpm -r --if-present test
scripts.verify:ci: pnpm run verify:foundation && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run build && pnpm run quality:impeccable
scripts.verify:precommit: pnpm exec lint-staged && pnpm run quality:commit
scripts.verify:published-content: pnpm run build:resume-pdf && pnpm --filter @aohys/content-graph typecheck && pnpm --filter @aohys/content-graph test && pnpm --filter @aohys/site typecheck && pnpm --filter @aohys/site build && pnpm --filter @aohys/site exec vitest run test/public-shell-build.test.ts test/public-routes-build.test.ts
